[[Image:A3_teamSwitch_dialogue.jpg|thumb]]
'''Team Switch''' is a feature introduced with [[:Category:ArmA: Armed Assault|{{arma1}}]] that provides the ability to switch between units.<br>
It is available in singleplayer and multiplayer.
* In Singleplayer, the player can switch between any unit set as ''playable'' in the editor
* In Multiplayer, switching is only possible with units '''on the same side'''.<br>Team Switch is available with Side respawn ([[Description.ext#respawn|respawn = 5]]).
{{Feature | arma3 |
* the '''Team Switch Dialogue''' can be opened by pressing '''U'''.
* a [[Arma 3: Mission Event Handlers#TeamSwitch|TeamSwitch Mission Event Handler]] is available.}}
